people.name: zerc00l
people.ru: Дал удалённый доступ к своему роутеру, и на его плате нашлась причина мёртвого Ethernet. До этого десятки перепрошивок и дампы стока и OpenWrt с одной платы.
people.en: Gave remote access to his router, and the cause of the dead Ethernet was found on his board. Before that, dozens of reflashes and stock and OpenWrt dumps from the same board.

people.name: Denchik777
people.ru: Первый дамп стока и вывод регуляторов, проверял каждую отладочную сборку на рабочей плате.
people.en: The first stock dump and regulator output, checked every debug build on a working board.

people.name: BurmecianKnight
people.ru: Тесты в issue #1, дамп загрузчика, замеры линии на стоке и на каждой сборке.
people.en: Tests in issue #1, a bootloader dump, lane measurements on stock and on every build.

people.name: fufliks862
people.ru: Первые отладочные логи, по ним стало видно, что линия поднимается только в одну сторону.
people.en: The first debug logs, which showed that the lane came up in one direction only.

people.name: dima-dior1999
people.ru: Первые сообщения о плате без сети и помощь другим в теме.
people.en: The first reports of a board without network, and help to others in the thread.

people.name: xiaoqi2020
people.ru: Логи с платы без сети в issue #4.
people.en: Logs from a board without network in issue #4.

people.name: tera2null
people.ru: Плата с ошибками приёма и откат на сток в issue #3.
people.en: A board with receive errors and the rollback to stock in issue #3.

people.name: kazanova-sgh
people.ru: extroot поверх общего тома и каталог стеков Docker.
people.en: extroot over the shared volume and the Docker stacks directory.

people.name: FOV5
people.ru: Подсказал хранить настройки OpenWrt в томе стока, с 1.2.6 откат на сток их не стирает.
people.en: Suggested keeping OpenWrt settings in the stock volume, since 1.2.6 a rollback to stock no longer wipes them.

people.en: The OpenWrt tree on kernel 6.18 for the BE7000 that this build is based on, and the EDMA receive DMA fix.

people.name: dima424658
people.ru: Первый запрос в OpenWrt с поддержкой BE7000.
people.en: The first pull request adding BE7000 support to OpenWrt.

people.en: The UNIPHY and USXGMII fix series for IPQ9574.

people.en: The Route10 port (SkytheFolf), the hint about resetting the QCA8084 from nsscc.
